stem: A class of 40 students has an average score of 81 on a test. The 16 boys have an average score of 75. What is the average score of the girls?
hints: Work with totals. Find the whole class's total and the boys' total.
Class total = 81 × 40. Boys' total = 75 × 16. The number of girls is 40 − 16.
Subtract to get the girls' total, then divide it by the number of girls.

solution.methodName: Weighted average: add group totals, divide by total count

steps.why: Total = average × count. By hand: 81 × 4 = 324, then × 10 = 3,240.
The class total is the boys' total plus the girls' total.
By hand, halve both numbers until it is easy: 2,040 ÷ 24 = 1,020 ÷ 12 = 510 ÷ 6 = 85.

trapNotes.51: This is 2,040 ÷ 40, dividing the girls' total by the whole class. Only 40 − 16 = 24 students are girls.
trapNotes.87: This puts 81 exactly halfway between 75 and the girls' average, as if there were as many boys as girls. There are 24 girls and only 16 boys.
trapNotes.2,040: This is the girls' total score. Divide it by the 24 girls to get their average.
